main_text.p: pud hostes habens, nepotem ex eo heredem instituas: non tantum si uiuo te filius decedat, sed etiam post mortem, antequam ab hostibus reuersus fuerit, succedendo nō rū-pet:nihil enim addidit, quo significaret tempus, nisi quod, licet audenter, possis dicere, uiuo patre hunc suum here-dē esse desisse, licet post mortem decedat: quia nec redit, nec potest redire.
main_text.head: Interpretatio.
main_text.p: Possit interpretatione induci.) Atqui hoc ita perspicuum est, ut non inductum, nec aduentitium esse, sed in ipsa lege insitū & innatū uideatur. Itaq; simili in specie Vlp.L.6.§.2. D.iniust.rupt.i-ta scribit: Si pater eius qui mortis aut

page.notes: The printed quotation marks in the right margin are typographic line markers, not text, so they are not transcribed. The first word "pud" is cut at the left edge of the scan; the initial letter may be lost, so it is copied as visible. The page ends mid-sentence; the word "tem." at the foot is the catchword. Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphens. The running head is read as "IN L. GALLVS.", with the first letters possibly faint.
